name: Add-Shop E-Retail Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2013, Add-Shop E-Retail Ltd manufactures and trades herbal, ayurvedic and agro commodities[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
Company is in the business of manufacturing, marketing and distribution of products viz. ayurvedic, food supplement, agricultural, animal feed supplement and personal care products under the brand name Add-Shop

pros: Stock is trading at 0.22 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 8.78% over last 3 years.
Company has high debtors of 229 days.
Promoter holding has decreased over last 3 years: -8.83%
